property_summary: For any recipient contract that reverts on receiving Ether, calls to sendTo by the owner always revert (so the call does not complete successfully) in the reference (which uses transfer and bubbles the revert), but the mutant (which uses send and ignores its boolean) can complete without reverting when the recipient reverts, violating that property for some inputs.
change_summary: Change transfer to send and ignore its boolean result, which will no longer revert on failure but instead return false (behavior differs when transfer would have reverted).
